use_cases.title: Pay for an enterprise order
use_cases.description: A Buyer or Procurement Manager completes payment for an enterprise order by choosing either purchase order payment against the enterprise credit line or a corporate card, supplying method-specific details that must validate, and being blocked when PO credit is exceeded, the corporate-card total is above the per-order cap, or repeated authorization failures lock the card form and route the user to support.
use_cases.summary: Complete payment by PO or corporate card.
use_cases.value: Converts an approved quote into a payable order while enforcing enterprise credit, card, and fraud-control rules.

cite.quote: The payment step offers two methods:

cites.quote: The payment step offers two methods:
**Purchase Order (on account)**
- **Buyer (Requester)** — employee in IT or Procurement who configures devices, builds quotes, and places orders. Has a per-order spending limit of $25,000.
- **Procurement Manager (Approver)** — reviews and approves or rejects orders that exceed a Buyer's spending limit. Can also build quotes and place orders, but cannot approve their own requests.

criteria.text: Payment offers Purchase Order (on account) and Corporate Card methods.

cite.quote: - PO number is required and must match the format `PO-` followed by 6 digits

criteria.text: PO payment is blocked when order total exceeds available credit of $150,000.00.

cite.quote: - The account's available credit is $150,000. If the order total exceeds available credit, the buyer sees "Order total exceeds available credit of $150,000.00. Pay by corporate card or contact your account manager." and cannot continue with PO

cite.quote: - Visa, Mastercard, and Amex; card number validated with a Luhn check; expiry must be in the future; CVV 3 digits (4 for Amex)

use_cases.title: Approve or reject a high-value enterprise order
use_cases.description: A Procurement Manager reviews pending approval requests for over-limit enterprise orders, sees request status and actions on the approvals page, must provide a sufficiently detailed rejection reason when declining, causes approval to place the order when accepting, and is prevented from approving or rejecting their own request while every decision is audit-recorded.
use_cases.summary: Review and decide high-value order requests.
use_cases.value: Enforces spending-policy compliance and segregation of duties before expensive enterprise purchases are committed.

cite.quote: - The Approvals page lists all requests with their status. Approvers see "Approve" and "Reject" actions on pending requests.

cites.quote: - The Approvals page lists all requests with their status. Approvers see "Approve" and "Reject" actions on pending requests.
- **Procurement Manager (Approver)** — reviews and approves or rejects orders that exceed a Buyer's spending limit. Can also build quotes and place orders, but cannot approve their own requests.
- **Security & Audit:** Every approval decision records approver, timestamp, and reason.

use_cases.title: Submit an over-limit enterprise order for approval

use_cases.summary: Route an over-limit order into approval.
use_cases.value: Routes expensive orders through policy-mandated review before commitment.

use_cases.title: Arrange shipping and delivery for an enterprise order

use_cases.value: Ensures the order can be delivered compliantly with accurate tax, freight, and lead-time calculation.
